name: Metro Booking Submitted (Pending)
subject: Metro Booking Received: ${booking_reference} (Pending Approval)
description: Notifies commuter that their booking has been received and is pending station manager review. Does NOT prematurely issue a ticket number.

name: Metro Booking Approval Requested
subject: ACTION REQUIRED: Approve Metro Booking ${booking_reference}
description: Alerts station duty managers of an incoming booking request requiring operational review.

name: Metro Booking Approved (Fulfillment In Progress)
subject: Metro Booking Approved: ${booking_reference} (Ticket Issuing)
description: Advises commuter that approval was granted and digital ticket generation is in progress.

name: Metro Digital Ticket Ready
subject: Your Metro Digital Pass is Ready: ${ticket_number}
description: Delivers the generated ticket number, portal access link, and attached vector SVG QR pass to the commuter.

name: Metro Booking Declined
subject: Metro Booking Declined: ${booking_reference}
description: Informs commuter that station operations declined the request, detailing the operational reason. Does not describe as passenger cancellation.

name: Metro Booking Cancelled
subject: Metro Booking Cancelled: ${booking_reference}
description: Confirms voluntary passenger cancellation and provides refund status if policy is active.

name: Metro Fulfillment Failure Alert
subject: ALERT: Fulfillment Exception on Metro Booking ${booking_reference}
description: Alerts IT and transit operations administrators of an exception during QR ticket generation.
